en:
<CLT=cltMIND>There doesn't seem to be anything
else of interest in this room.

It doesn't look like there's anything important
here... Just an empty room.

Oh! This not only empty room. You see
three same-looking doors in hall, right?

All those rooms empty, just like this one.
And they only got candles for light too.
Ah, so there are three of them.

Anyway, we no gotta worry. No reason we
ever need to use empty room like this.

Then...can we leave soon? The darkness and
this shaky floor are making me nervous.

It's only a matter of time before the shutters
burst open and a newspaper gets blown in.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't have any reason to
waste time in an empty room.
